title: Delayed Auditory Feedback EEG/EGG
description: This dataset contains EEG, electroglottography (EGG), and audio recordings from participants exposed to delayed auditory feedback (DAF) during speech production. The data were collected to investigate the neural and vocal responses to auditory feedback delays, capturing both brain activity and vocal fold vibration patterns synchronized with speech and altered auditory feedback timing.
methods_description: EGG and audio signals were recorded on the same hardware as the EEG data and are embedded within the EEG files rather than as separate sidecar files. EGG data were minimally preprocessed to correct for phase delays introduced by the amplifier's built-in hardware filter, using a zero-phase-shift software filter. Data were organized according to the BIDS standard using the MNE-BIDS software.
